note: The native-member join (SCB Vardemangder by CVID, item validity from VardemangderValidDates) and the declared-list join (canonical SCB lists by name) seen at the built value sets, one register per replaced claim. Expected values are the replaced tests' asserted outcomes read through the fixture: each register's state is its delivered year (or pooled range), and its codes are its Vardemangder rows. Issue refs are the fixture's coordinates in the record-ref grammar. The old tests' missing-ValidDates legs (`missing="unknown"`) cannot be built: the snapshot refuses Vardemangder without VardemangderValidDates (test_scb_snapshot_selection.py), so an unknown item window (`bad|bad`) stands in for an unknown validity source. SETASIDE (1990, items valid from 2008-11-19), PARTIAL (2008, items valid from 2008-11-19 and 2009-01-01) and POOLEDASIDE (pooled 2010-2014, items valid from 2012-01-04): an edition-listed item whose global dates miss or cut its edition keeps the whole edition, with a set-aside warning, never a day-cut or empty state. POOLED: items valid 2019-2023 bind over exactly the pooled 2020-2022 range, with no warning. UNKSCOPE/RANGELESS: no range, no coding. MARKER/MARKERMIX: a `Tal` type marker is not a member (no claim, no issue; beside a code only that code), and its item's unknown window (`bad|bad`) is never checked. UNKVALID (unknown window) vs UNLISTED (no window row): unknown validity withholds the list with both errors, an unlisted item is unrestricted. ASIDEUNK: an unknown item beside a set-aside one still withholds. COLLIDE: CVID tokens 045001 and 45001 name one member, so its two complete lists conflict even with dates outside the edition. GROUPED: binding errors are grouped per descriptor. IDCLEAN/IDUNK/IDNOLABEL/IDJOIN: a declared identifier drops a list with unknown validity or membership without an issue and keeps a clean one; UNKVALID and NOLABEL are the non-identifier twins, and IDBLANK (a blank Unika flag with no Identifierare row) and IDNONE (no Unika row) the unknown- and missing-flag twins, which keep both errors. CHECKED: an `[[errata.occurrence_period]]` moving 2020 to 2021-onward carries the coding to the corrected open period. ROWVALID: canonical row validity (from 2008-11-19) is a restriction, never set aside, so 1990 has no active member. NAMED binds only its own list name; FKREG's FKVAR names a delivered FK list, which is outside the canonical declared-list namespace, and its FKCANON names the canonical named-list itself from the FK source, so each is reported not found.
fails_if: any one of: `bind` stops setting aside global item dates for an edition-listed SCB item (setaside, partial and pooledaside lose their codes) or sets them aside past an unknown window (asideunk publishes); `coding_scope_bounds` stops carrying a pooled edition's range, so pooled reports unsupported_coding_scope and loses 01, or gives a rangeless scope bounds (unkscope, rangeless bind); a `Tal` type-marker row becomes a member (marker gains `Tal`) or has its item validity checked (marker and markermix report unknown_code_validity); an unlisted item reads as unknown validity, or an unknown window as unrestricted (unlisted, unkvalid); the declared-identifier drop is removed (idclean, idunk, idnolabel, idjoin report errors) or applied to non-identifiers (unkvalid, nolabel publish) or to an unknown or missing flag (idblank's or idnone's two errors vanish); the Identifierare join stops supplying the identifier to coding (idjoin reports unknown_code_validity); zero-padded CVID tokens stop naming their member (collide publishes one list); binding errors are reported per association instead of per descriptor (grouped gets three); occurrence-period corrections bind coding at the original 2020 edition (checked); row validity is set aside like item validity (rowvalid gains 01); or a declared list binds across provider namespaces (fkcanon binds 01 First and its not-found issue vanishes)
